parameters: Welcome!  I can hook you up with some beds for \V[10]\G.
"What?  All we've got is \V[1].  Aw man...
Sorry sir, I guess we'll go..."
Party has enough money, but do they want to get rooms?
Welcome!  I can hook you up with some beds for \V[10]\G.
"Hi guys, can I get ya some weapons?"
"Up for some armor?  Clothing?  Armored clothing?  All magical, of course."
"I have a variety of books, rings, and things, for sale."
"Hey, what happened to the door we just went through?  I KNOW I'm not going crazy.  Just about no one does that these days."
"Ya know, I couldn't help but notice it too.  That door just isn't there any more."
"Well at least they rolled out a red carpet for us."
"Yeah, how about that, whoever 'they' are.  Why don't we talk to some of these people here and find out what's up with that?"
"Well, my shirt isn't magically hopping off my skin and into my pocket, so it can't be TOO dangerous...
That and these people here aren't attacking us or anything, they look friendly enough."
"Hey did you guys just come from between the two dragons!?  All right!!!  We've been waiting since before I was born for you
guys!  You're the legendary heros that are gonna win our castle back and free us!  I can't wait to see what the sky looks like -
I've seen pictures but I've never been outside and seen it before!  Hey what does wind feel like, ya know, outside?
"Whoa!  Slowwwwww down there, little buddy!  I can tell you've been in this place your whole life or something, huh?
Yup, we just got here, we're not from your town, and we came from between the two dragons.  If you've been cooped up in here you're whole life
and have never seen the outdoors, I wouldn't mind doing something about that- Uh, just what are we supposed to be destined to do, anyways?"
"I was always told my whole life about five guys and one woman, all of them young, who are supposed to be from a faraway land who show
up if we put out the red carpet, who come and kill The Big Bad Guy and his army that took over this castle many years ago, and trapped us
inside these chambers until you heros come and save us, while, um, looking for something that has to do with a, uh, special toilet paper
dispenser that has folded paper in a box thingy instead of a roll or something?  I studied in school, but can't figure that out..."
"Aw dude!  Now I see how this fits together...
Um, it's a really long story, and kinda hard to explain, but trust me on this, I think you're gonna finally see the sun and the sky for
real, really soon.  Take my word for it big guy, things are gonna happen..."
You quietly mutter out of the side of your mouth to one of your friends.
"I'm not lying to this kid, am I?"
"Probably not, assuming we pull it off, meaning we kill The Big Bad Guy and get the special treasure that enlightens two rival towns with how
they can dispense toilet paper, bringing peace and prosperity, I guess...
I'm guessing that's what Zinkland wrote out for this adventure as DM, anyways..."
"Aw man, I can't wait!  And this is happening in MY lifetime!!!  YES!!!"
"Wow.  Goodness!  We have visitors to our town, and six of them, five young men and one young woman, exactly as it says in
prophecy!  I'm...  I'm...  I can't believe it!  I didn't think it would ever happen, and here you are!
Somehow I thought that if this day ever come it would feel different than this...   Well!  Welcome to our town,
our chambers down deep in this castle mostly taken over by evil for generations, where we've been waiting for six heros!"
"Um, hi.  We're just six students from Acrydia Community College.  We ARE from far away, not these lands or anywhere nearby, and
we do actually want to end something so we can all go back home.  Are you sure we're these heros you're talking about?
"No!  No one else!  At least not according to my great grandfather before he died, ever since our castle was taken over and our people were
imprisoned in these chambers, at least not the six heros described in prophecy.  The only other one was one single man, who was exiled from
where he lived, as a punishment of some kind, but he is by himself and he doesn't fit the description in the prophecy.  We found out he was
a greedy man indeed, and can see why he was exiled, a twisted man named Niko.  By any chance, do you know him?"
"Oh that guy.  Yeah, we know who Niko is, though he's not our friend or anything.  Yeah he can be greedy, long story.
Mind if we walk around a bit, and talk to some people?"
"Go ahead!  Of course!  Stay at our Inn, and shop at our stores, if you wish!  Some of my fellow people here know more about the
prophecy than I do, I admit.
From what I studied in school, I think you six are actually destined to do that, and figure out what you need to do and then return
home or something, after freeing our people so we have our castle back and can once again breathe fresh outside air!"
"Here's the way out of our little town and into the depths of the castle.  If you need to come back and rest up while going about
your quest, you can always return to our town and we'll let you back in.  Good luck with it.  If you six
really are the ones with a destiny to save us, the door WILL open for you and let you back in, not to mention
let you go out in the first place."
"Well I'll be...  I never thought I'd see the six young heros of destiny...  I wasn't sure if the prophecy was real or not
my whole life, if you would ever come, at least not in my lifetime!"
"Oh!  It's true!  I've always wondered if you'd come in my lifetime, and I might get to see the night-time sky, and
see what STARS really look like in the sky!  I also studied about sunrises and sunsets, growing up!"
"I gotta say, I got my hopes up when that man Niko came along, then felt certain the prophecy was fake when he turned out to be
a man from a nearby town, exiled, and not a hero.  THIS, though, seeing you guys right now in front of me, this is a real
"Well this just makes my day!  How do you do, heros?  Win this war for us!  Knock 'em dead!"
"The heros!  You came!  The prophecy must be true after all!  My grandparents grew up with stories about the outside world,
and now its actually going to happen!"
"Oh, don't mind me, I'm just a bit overwhelmed...  Can't wait to find out if The Big Bad Guy and his evil army will really
"Most of us study the prophecy when we're young, then give up on it and forget what we've studied when we get older.  You could ask one
of our town's schoolchildren about it, I'm sure they could tell you a lot more than I could!"
"The Big Bad Guy, for as long as I've been alive, has had his evil army patrol the halls of this great castle, past the exit door.
He has all sorts of evil soldiers, spellcasters, machines, and monsters out there.  Only a few stepped out, made it
about TEN FEET or so, and came back really hurting to tell about it!"
"Do you know anything about those evil monsters and stuff?  Like what their weaknesses are, or what types of powers they have?
Anything that might help us fight them?"
"Nope, far as I know, I don't know anything that would help you plan your strategy, sorry.  I don't think anyone in this
town really knows that stuff, so you heros might have to figure it out on your own.  Again, sorry."
"Hail, epic heros of destiny!  I regret that I've forgotten the sacred teachings of the prophecy that I studied in school
growing up, so I don't have any real hints or clues to give you for taking on The Big Bad Guy or his evil army, sorry.
But, hail!  And good luck out there!"
"Who is The Big Bad Guy anyways?  Is he even a person?  A machine?  A monster?"
"Sorry, I forgot the teachings years ago...  But, um, hail, great heros of destiny!  Hail!"
"By any chance does the name Zinkland ring any bells?"
"No, I forgot anyways, great heros!  Um, hail!  A toast!  To destiny!"
The man raises a mug, making a toast in your honor.  You understand that you aren't going to get
much out of this guy, no slide rule required.
"Aw man!  The six heros!  Hey, you guys look just like how it says in destiny, that I'm studying in school!  Wow..."
"Um, can you tell us our story?  Like what we're supposed to do?"
"Yeah!  You guys go and kill The Big Bad Guy, and that stops his evil army!  Then that's gonna let us have our castle back, and come and go from
it when we want to and see the outside day and night!  And then you're gonna get a reward from the treasury, and it's kinda weird.  Its a toilet
paper dispenser with some special design that makes two nearby towns both happy.  And so then they're gonna stop fighting each other.  And then
you six are gonna get rewarded for it with a way back home, to the faraway place you come from, that you've been trying to get back to!"
"Yeah, I know, like I said, weird.  Kinda like a funny plot for a movie or something, but my Dad said 'Well this is real life.'
Yeah I just finished a big report on it for school last week."
"Hey, I'm glad you studied so hard, big guy.  Thanks!"
"Yeah my mom and dad said it would pay off.  I had NO IDEA it would be like THIS, so that I could tell the ACTUAL HEROS
"Hi there, welcome to my little side-street pawn shop.  I think I have stuff you guys could use.
I want copper bars, and if you find any, I'm willing to trade them for tool kits that will detect traps, open locks, and find secret doors."
"Come back when you find copper bars, and we'll trade, alright?"
"Do you want to trade all your copper bars for toolkits?  You get three kits for each bar, one trap detection kit, one secret door detection kit, and one
You get \V[1] Secret Door Detection 3 kits.
"I see you had Niko spared, and freed from the lockup.
Glad you turned out to be good after all, Niko!  It seems the heros here saw the good in you."
"Why, thank you sir!  I'll be sure not to disappoint!"
"I heard about that slimeball Niko and what happened to him.  I guess he shouldn't have been forgiven like that.  He must
have been rotten to the core.  Well, now he can rot in the halls, devoured by monsters that lurk there."
"That man who came here before you heros showed up - I think his name is Niko - He mentioned you six.
Right now, he's in our jail.  Our town lockup is at the south end, past the chambers where people live.  This spot right here is
"Thanks for the tip.  We might pay him a visit."
"Hey, I've got some old weapons for sale.  Take a look."
"Hi, I don't have much, just older-style guns for sale."
"Old armored clothing for sale!  A bit dated, but it works!"
"Well hello.  Welcome, heros, to our town's jail.
If you haven't already done so, you might want to talk to our newest prisoner, the man named Niko who says he knows you six.
We locked him up because he is charged with theft, and hasn't been to trial yet."
"Really?  I figured he was a sinister man of sorts.  Don't worry, we'll deal with him, and keep our town safe from him."
"Well hello.  Welcome, heros, to our town's jail.
If you haven't already done so, you might want to talk to our newest prisoner, the man named Niko who says he knows you six.
We locked him up because he is charged with theft, and hasn't been to trial yet."
"I talked with Niko and he's actually not a bad man.  He helped us find and rescue a lost boy from monsters in a sewer.
We worked together to do it, and I was angry at him for some...  something kinda dumb afterwards, but I forgive him.
Any chance you could let him go?"
"Well, that's interesting!  I guess I misjudged that man.
Very well, I'll forward your words on his character to the court, for his trial, but until his trial he needs to stay where he is.
That's all for now, as I need to get back to work."
"Well, that's interesting!  I guess I misjudged that man.
Very well, I'll forward your words on his character to the court, for his trial, but until his trial he needs to stay where he is.
That's all for now, as I need to get back to work."
"Well, that's interesting!  I guess I misjudged that man.
Very well, I'll forward your words on his character to the court, for his trial, but until his trial he needs to stay where he is.
That's all for now, as I need to get back to work."
"Well, that's interesting!  I guess I misjudged that man.
Very well, I'll authorize for him to be set free, but ONLY on the condition that he stay with you six people.  Fair enough?"
The man gestures towards a guard, who comes back with Niko.
"You're all set!  We're done here, thank you.  I need to get back to some paperwork."
"I'm sorry to hear that Niko was a scoundrel and evil man the whole time.
In the future, you should be careful who you speak up for."
"\P[1], these people misunderstand me badly!  Please tell them what kind of person I am!  I confess, I admit that when we
saved Kaito I was greedy, but I fought to find and save him in the first place.  I am so very sorry, and I wish I could
apologize again to Kaito's mother...  She didn't want to speak to me when I was being judged, then kicked out of the town...
Please \P[1], forgive me!  That's all I ask!"
"Ya know you're really full of shit, Niko.  You were greedy all right, and I can see how someone like you ended up in jail in a new town.
You put a fucking knife to an innocent ten-year-old boy's throat, and made him bleed!  If these people don't understand what kind of guy you
are, I'd be happy to tell them how much you're fucking evil slime!  You don't deserve to be let off easy, not like that.
You can't just do something like that to a kid and his mom and expect to deserve to be forgiven like that!  No way!  Logic fail!"
"NO Niko, you're where you belong!  That's that, and I'm NOT sorry - If I said that I was sorry in any way I'd be lying to you, and
I'm not going to do that.  I'm telling you straight, I'm NOT sorry that you're EXACTLY where you belong and should be!  That's right,
that sharp edge of that thing called JUSTICE when you've done wrong!  Well, it's supposed to hurt like a bitch sometimes!  That's if
you've done evil.  As the saying goes, if you don't wanna do the time, don't do the crime!"
"I'm sorry too.  I forgive you.  You did go with us to save that kid, and maybe you didn't have to do that.  I'm sorry I was angry
at you after we rescued him.  Maybe his mother didn't understand any of that either, I don't know...
I'll go tell the guard to reconsider your fate."
You're not going to bother.  Niko isn't worth it, and you've said what you wanted to say to him.
You see a boy with a tigerstone face - like yourself, probably young because of how he's dressed, with dragon white skin, also like yourself.  He's wearing black
basketball shorts with a black hat, and has orange hair.  He's also shirtless, and from being born with your own dragon white skin, you're well aware that having
dragon white skin means that you're immune to extreme temperatures including burning fire and ice, and don't have to dress for the weather.  These chambers deep
inside the castle are far from the sun and feel cool and drafty, and don't bother you or this boy no matter how much or how little either of you wear.
All half dragons and common humans with dragon white skin are like this.  Zarakite dragons enjoy such immunity to extreme temperatures no matter what skin they
have. Like you, this boy has what is called a "tigerstone face," which refers to the shape of his facial features, and with it the way his voice sounds.  While
you and this boy are not from the same family, and aren't related, you both have the same DNA for your faces and your vocal cords.  A certain percentage of
half dragons are tigerstones, and there are no common humans with tigerstone faces known to exist, only half dragons and dragons can have such a face.
Tigerstones, for reference, can have pure white skin, caucasian white skin, and brown skin tones.  Possible hair colors for caucasian white and dragon white
skin-toned tigerstones include black, brown, blond, orange, red, blue, pink, and pale violet.  This kid has orange hair, human-looking eyes, and no body
hair, which means that he's either a teenager or in his early twenties like yourself, and he's a half dragon and not a dragon.
You can tell that this kid is a natural tigerstone, meaning he was born with a tigerstone face and tigerstone DNA.  You can tell because he walks, talks, and
moves like you do, telling you his personality comes from the same DNA as what you have.
When you approach, he lights up and greets you the same way you would, and of course talks the same way you do.
"Dude!  Another tigerstone!  Aw man, 'sup?  I heard that the heros came to town, but man no one told me that one of them was another tigerstone!  Aw man
you've got dragon skin and muscles just like me too!  Holy shit!  Hey I see you're into fighting with two-handed swords, from that piece you're carrying,
"Hey look, you wanna swordfight?  I could really use the practice, and of course its not like I have any problem getting my head
chopped off or anything.  Come on, just for fun?  I'd love to get my head cut off by one of the prophecy heros!
Just you by yourself against me though!  What do ya say?"
"Hey \P[1]!  'Sup?  Hey good to see you again.  Wanna go again at a swordfight?  Just you and me, like last time!  C'mon, we
both know we'd love it!  Hey, chop my head off if ya can!"

You stand in victory, holding the boy's severed head.
He seems as excited as ever, thrilled by the fight, even though he lost:
"Aw dude!!!  Man that was so fucking incredible...  Aw man did I really enjoy that!  Hey you were really good!  Thanks!"
The boy's decapitated body stands up, and dusts itself off.  He holds out his hands, and you hand him his head, which he re-attaches.
"Aw man...  Hey I was expecting to lose!  Geez and you're one of the heros...  If anyone finds out that one of you six-
Um, never mind, I'll just pretend that didn't happen and you kicked my ass...  Oh boy...  Shit I'm glad no one saw that..."
// Restore actors other than main character
"Okay, well if ya change your mind I'll be here.  I'm kinda hard to miss."
